leadText: (Japanese: の まり The Story Begins) is the first regular chapter of the manga. It was first published in the May 2023 issue of CoroCoro Comics, released on April 14, 2023. It is based on the episodes The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) and The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two). It is 49 pages long, including the color cover.

(Japanese: の まり The Story Begins) is the first regular chapter of the manga. It was first published in the May 2023 issue of CoroCoro Comics, released on April 14, 2023. It is based on the episodes The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) and The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two). It is 49 pages long, including the color cover.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Liko, a beginner from Paldea, enrolls in the Indigo Academy in Kanto.
Liko receives a as her first partner Pokémon.
Liko has her first Pokémon battle and loses.
Liko meets Amethio and gets on the radar of the mysterious Explorers organization.
Liko meets Pokémon Professor Friede for the first time.
Liko is introduced to the Rising Volt Tacklers.
